sources.label: 令和8年第2回定例会 議案の内容

name: 寄附金控除や医療費控除の規定を見直す
summary: 区の特別区税条例を、地方税法などの改正に合わせて見直します。寄附金税額控除の税率や対象となる信託財産、年金受給者の申告書提出義務、医療費控除の特例の期限などを改めます。
changes: 寄附金税額控除の算定に使う税率を改める
寄附金控除の対象となる信託財産に有価証券や不動産などを加える
扶養親族等申告書の提出義務の対象に、所得税で源泉徴収の対象とならない公的年金等の受給者を加える
特定一般用医薬品等購入費に関する医療費控除の特例の適用期限をなくすなど、特例措置の規定を改める
who: 寄附金控除の対象となる信託財産を寄附する人
公的年金等を受給する人
特定一般用医薬品等を購入し、医療費控除の特例を利用する人
why: 地方税法等の一部改正に伴う改正のためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Revises rules on donation deductions and medical expense deductions
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Nerima City Special Ward Tax Ordinance
en.summary: The ward will revise its special ward tax ordinance to reflect amendments to the Local Tax Act and other laws. The changes include the tax rate for the donation tax credit, the trust assets eligible for the donation deduction, the declaration requirements for pension recipients, and the time limit for the special medical expense deduction.
changes: Revises the tax rate used to calculate the donation tax credit and adds securities, real estate, and other assets to the trust assets eligible for the donation deduction
Adds recipients of public pensions and other benefits who are not subject to income-tax withholding at source to those required to submit a declaration of dependants and other information

Revises the rules for the special medical expense deduction for purchases of specified over-the-counter medicines and similar products, including removing the time limit for applying the special measure
who: People who donate trust assets eligible for the donation deduction
People who receive public pensions and other benefits
People who buy specified over-the-counter medicines and similar products and use the special medical expense deduction
en.why: The ward says this amendment is being made in response to partial amendments to the Local Tax Act and other laws.
